summary.text: Pamela Helming is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 54 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Helming has served in the Senate since 2017 and is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Pamela Helming has represented State Senate District 54 since 2017.

In the 2025-2026 session she is ranking member of the Insurance Committee and is also assigned to the Cultural Affairs, Tourism, Parks and Recreation; Housing, Construction and Community Development; Rules; Agriculture; Finance; and Racing, Gaming and Wagering committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Helming faces Michael Mills (D).
